newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pac mulls listing telephone unit.
newsitem.headline: First Pac mulls listing telephone unit.

text.p: First Pacific Co Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks on restructuring and spinning off its mobile telephone business but no agreement had been reached.

"The company is participating in discussions, which are being led by Asia Link...with several parties but merely as part of Asia Link's ongoing efforts to enhance its telecommunications businesses, prospects and profitability," First Pacific said in a statement.
Asia Link Holdings Ltd, a cellular telephone network operator 65 percent owned by First Pacific, holds the company's telecommunications operations in Asia.

"There has not been any agreement finalised with any party concerning any joint venture with Asia Link in its interests in any telecommunications networks located in Hong Kong, China or Taiwan or any decision to list such business," it said.

First Pacific said it made the statement in response to press reports about the possible sale of a substantial stake in the company's mobile cellular telephone businesses in Hong Kong, China and Taiwan and a possible listing of the combined businesses under a new corporate entity.
Shares of First Pacific were up HK$0.70 to HK$10.50 in late trade on Tuesday.
